name: Sant Martí Sesgueioles (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the white horse of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 30 August 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3479 of 25 September 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the white horse of the arms 2/3 of the height and 11/18 of the length at the centre.

features.role: horse of the arms, 2/3 of the height
